name: engineering
description: What the warehouse extraction writes today: facts about product features, one entity per feature name, in nine kinds. Plus findings: compiled, tagged statements a compile step writes from many episodes.

feature.description: A product feature or component, named in lower case (csv export, notetaker).

finding.description: One self-contained statement about the system that a compile step wrote from many episodes for a job (reviewing a change, fixing an error), tagged so it can be filtered. Each compile is a set, valid until the next compile's set replaces it.

text.description: The statement, naming its module or file and quoting identifiers and error text verbatim.

kind.description: failure-mode: a way it breaks, and the mechanism; signature: what a failure looks like (exception and error text); regression: a past change that broke something, and why; fix-pattern: how such a bug was fixed.

area.description: The part of the system it belongs to, as the compile named it.

path.description: The file or directory it is about, if any.

topic.description: The feature, flag, table or endpoint it is about, if any.

guidance: Findings say what to check before changing something and what an error means: filter type finding by kind, area or path (contains), and rank by text.
